routing_contract.when_to_use: Use when watching an active launch window (T-0 to T+30): verifying instrumentation before launch (UTM and conversion events per surface), polling HN rank/points/comments with a flamewar early-warning, Product Hunt votes/featured status, app-store charts and reviews, and news echo; producing D0/W1/M1 KPI snapshots vs targets, spike-vs-sustain and owned-capture reads, and threshold alerts. The window watcher below the day-of runbook (launch-day-conductor) and upstream of the retro (launch-retro-analyzer).
